{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id values: {df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()}")

# Check sample_seq distribution to confirm re-testing
print(f"Unique sample_seq values: {sorted(df['sample_seq'].unique())}")

# Check assay_batch values
print(f"Assay batch distribution: {df['assay_batch'].value_counts().to_dict()}" )"}
